name: Parent Notice of Change of Address
description: Families who move within or out of the District must notify the Registrar of the move and new address.
deadline: immediately, but in no event more than five (5) days after such move
quote: Student's whose parents/guardians move within or outside of the District's boundaries are required to immediately, but in no event more than five (5) days after such move, notify the District's Registrar of such move and change of address.
